mentions.name: Codex
mentions.description: An open-source, file/git-based single-person documentation store for dropping in and displaying markdown notes, with a built-in MCP server for asking questions about the stored docs.
mentions.source_excerpt: Ongoing maintenance of my badly-named open-sourced tool called Codex (https://github.com/bocan/codex).  It's like a file/git based 1 person doc store that I use at work to drop markdown into, display it, with a built-in MCP server that I can use to ask it questions.
